purpose: Storage-light constructive benchmark of delete-two/add-three completions from the pinned verified 42-vertex catalog.
sampling_rule: Sixteen catalog lines rounded from an equally spaced grid spanning 1..328. Each line contributes one cyclic long-span deletion pair (labels separated by 21) and one cyclic adjacent deletion pair.

encoding.variable_order: 40 A-core, 40 B-core, 40 C-core, AB, AC, BC
encoding.clauses: homogeneous core 4-sets with one new vertex, triples with two new vertices, and pairs with all three new vertices

worker_mode: four persistent C++ processes, one exact eight-pair shard each
record_policy: One compact summary JSON containing all 32 records; no per-core files unless a SAT model is found.

status_policy.SAT: The C++ worker stops immediately. Atomically preserve the raw model, reconstruct the 43-vertex graph, and require both independent graph verifiers before certification.
status_policy.UNSAT: Record OBSERVED_UNSAT_UNCHECKED with negative_certified=false and no proof. This is only a reproducible computational observation.
status_policy.ERROR: Fail the exact coverage audit and make no aggregate claim.

immutable_stop_rules: Do not launch until available disk is at least 2155872256 bytes, preserving a 2 GiB reserve even if the full 8 MiB output cap is consumed.
Never write more than 8388608 bytes under the pilot output directory and never produce any artifact approaching 50 MB.
Stop ordinary work on the first SAT status for immediate model preservation and dual verification.
Stop and report incomplete on hash drift, pair-order mismatch, worker error, wall-cap breach, output-cap breach, or reserve breach.
UNSAT and LIMIT statuses are never certified negative outcomes in this pilot.
scope_warning: Every outcome concerns one fixed induced 40-vertex catalog core. Negative observations imply no global order-43 nonexistence and change no Ramsey bound.
